meaning: Card OP-APP-RK-CALLBACKS-VIA-POLL-CB (gateway rule 12n, user decisions R1 and F1): units of the production compile database the member-facts pre-pass does not read, each with its recorded evidence. Every other unit is preprocessed; a unit that names a token of an invoked member's closure and cannot be read as C opens every member. Schema 2 (card MEMBER-PREPASS-OTHER-ROUTES): `evidence_revision` is the Fluent Bit revision the recorded evidence was taken at, and each entry's `evidence` is re-verified by the pre-pass against the run's own sources and its final tokens. `tokens-absent`: the unit's raw text, every file Clang resolves for it under its own command and the named generator sources (relative to the source root; a directory is every file under it) name no token, and every include Clang leaves unresolved is named in `generated`. `not-linked`: the named link lines (relative to the CMake build root) name `linked` and not `unlinked`. An exclusion that does not hold is dropped and its unit read like any other.

outside_program.why: librdkafka's C++ wrapper (target rdkafka++, CMakeCache rdkafka++_LIB_DEPENDS); the fluent-bit-bin and fluent-bit-shared link lines (src/CMakeFiles/*/link.txt) link librdkafka.a and not librdkafka++, so these units are not part of the audited program
